# Secrets Handling

**Pattern:**

- Never print, log, or pass a token on a command line. Use a file, stdin, or
  an environment variable read inside the process.
- Restrict the token file ACL to the owning account.
- Run a secret-shaped scan on the staged diff before every commit. Exempt only
  explicit fake test fixtures, matched by literal value, never by pattern or
  path.

**Why:** command lines appear in process listings, shell history, and logs.
Pattern or path exemptions let real secrets slip through.

**When:** any script, agent, or CI step that handles credentials. See also
[Local Config Split](local-config-split.md) for keeping secrets out of git.
